rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In the joint solemn session of 1 January 2019 (15:02-15:42) Jair Messias Bolsonaro took the constitutional oath and the President of the National Congress (Eunício Oliveira) declared him empossado as President 'para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2019 a 31 de dezembro de 2022'; the Termo de Posse read into the record states that at 15:00 on 1 January 2019 he was solemnly given office.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The minutes and the termo de posse read into the record state that Jair Bolsonaro was elected President of the Republic on 28 October 2018.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address at the same session of 1 January 2019, after the posse, the President of the National Congress referred to 'o ex-Presidente Michel Temer'.

locator.passage: 'não posso deixar de registrar a perseverança política e pessoal do ex-Presidente Michel Temer'

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The President of Congress opened the session to give office to the President and to the Vice-President of the Republic, 'Sr. Antonio Hamilton Martins Mourão', elected on 28 October 2018; the termo read into the record repeats that both were elected on 28 October 2018.

locator.section: opening declaration by Eunício Oliveira; termo on pdf p. 7

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Invited as 'Vice-Presidente da República eleito', Antonio Hamilton Martins Mourão took the constitutional oath before Congress on 1 January 2019, after the President-elect.

locator.section: 'Convido o Exmo. Sr. Vice-Presidente da República eleito ...' and 'O SR. ANTONIO HAMILTON MARTINS MOURÃO - Prometo manter ...'; signed termo de compromisso on pdf p. 18 (source br_cn_dcn1_20190102_full)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The session was called to give office to the President and the Vice-President 'para o período a iniciar-se nesta data'; after the oaths the President of Congress (Eunício Oliveira) declared Jair Messias Bolsonaro and Antonio Hamilton Martins Mourão 'empossados nos cargos de Presidente e Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil ... respectivamente, para o período de 1º de janeiro de 2019 a 31 de dezembro de 2022'. The session ran from 15:02 to 15:42.

locator.section: opening declaration and 'declaro empossados'; session times on pdf p. 5

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The First Secretary read the Termo de Posse: at 15:00 on 1 January 2019, before Congress in joint session in the Chamber's plenary, Jair Messias Bolsonaro and Antonio Hamilton Martins Mourão were solemnly empossados under art. 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President, respectively, elected on 28 October 2018 and diplomados by the TSE on 10 December 2018, for the period 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2022; the termo was then signed by the President 'agora empossado', by the Vice-President 'também empossado' and by the Mesa.

locator.section: 'TERMO DE POSSE ... NOS CARGOS DE PRESIDENTE E VICE-PRESIDENTE DA REPÚBLICA' and the Presidency's announcement of the signatures

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In his address to Congress after the posse, President Bolsonaro saluted the 'Vice-Presidente da República Federativa do Brasil, Sr. Hamilton Mourão'; the President of Congress's closing address also saluted him as Vice-President.

locator.section: opening salutations of Bolsonaro's address; Eunício Oliveira's address on pdf p. 10
